keys.comment: FloofyCrew public-edition registry signing key (floofycrew-registry index.json/compat.json), generated 2026-09-19 by task 7.1

notes: The GitHub organisation `floofycrew` is a placeholder until the owner creates the public registry repository (task 7.5); change `sources[].url`, `sources[].repo` and `archiveUrlTemplate` together when it lands. `keys[]` may hold several records during a key rotation. `selfUpdate` (task 10.7) is the FloofyCrew release feed of this edition: the GitHub releases API of the same repository (`releases/latest`: the tag names the version, the body is the build's RELEASE.md with its Supports lines and assets table) and the release assets `floofy.pyz`, `SHA256SUMS` and the Loader app archive; it moves with the organisation.
